name: The Passion Residence Lagoon
shortDescription: A boutique development of seven newly built townhomes in the Ko Kaeo area near Boat Lagoon, completed in 2025.
description: A boutique development of seven newly built townhomes in the Ko Kaeo area near Boat Lagoon, completed in 2025. Each home has its own layout, with parking, a garden and security on site.
